answer_1.quote: We validate the effectiveness of our approaches on two important generation tasks: question generation and data-to-text generation, via both automatic evaluation metrics and human evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: questions and natural language text descriptions

answer_2.quote: For question generation, we present results on the SQuAD QG dataset, and for data-to-text NLG, we choose the WebNLG dataset.

answer_4.quote: We performed anonymous human evaluation studies using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk).
answer_4.guideline: For question generation, relevance is defined as how clearly the generated question will be able to point to the right answer, given an input paragraph as context. For WebNLG data-to-text, relevance is defined as how related is the generated description w.r.t. the given RDF data such as mentioning the facts. For both tasks, coherence is based on the logic, readability, and fluency of the generated question or description.
